release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.2

- Video Call Camera Controls: Host can now turn on/re-enable cameras for individual participants.
- Turn Off / Turn On All Cameras: Common one-tap batch camera control for all meeting participants.
- In-Call Volume Controls: Built-in volume control dialog with real-time volume slider (up to 200% boost) & +/- buttons.
- Hardware Volume Buttons: Fixed physical volume up/down buttons during active video and audio calls.
- Host Early Ringing: 30-second persistent ringing notification for the host when participants join early.
- Scheduled Call Details & UI fixes: Smoother navigation and enhanced privacy.
- Performance improvements and bug fixes across video and audio streaming.
